content.stem: 使用人工智能（AI）和机器学习技术进行负面媒体报道筛查，可以：（选择三项。）

options.A: 确保所有负面媒体来源都得到全面分析，而无需人工审查
options.B: 通过提供一致且高度准确的分析，显著减少重复性任务产生的人为错误
options.C: 能够立即识别媒体文章背后的意图，从而更有效地进行风险评分
options.D: 自动识别新信息并将其与以前遇到的数据区分开来
options.E: 覆盖多种语言和文字，超越人类语言能力的局限

content.stem_en: Using artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning-based techniques in adverse media screening can: (Choose three.)

options_en.A: Ensure that all adverse media sources are comprehensively analyzed without the need for human review.
options_en.B: Significantly reduce human errors arising from repetitive tasks by delivering consistent and highly accurate analysis.
options_en.C: Instantly identify intent behind media articles, allowing for more effective risk scoring.
options_en.D: Automate the process of identifying new information and distinguishing it from previously encountered data.
options_en.E: Cover multiple languages and scripts, surpassing the limitations of human linguistics.
